feed.title: Alberto's Web
feed.subtitle: Alberto Merino, PhD student at the University of Castilla-La Mancha (UCLM) working on congestion control and flow control in high-performance interconnection and data-center networks.

entry.title: New preprint: PCM, Programmable Congestion Management for Terabit RDMA NICs
entry.content: New preprint out: PCM: Programmable Congestion Management for Terabit RDMA NICs, a portable programming model for congestion control and load balancing on datacenter NICs, evaluated on NVIDIA ConnectX-8, Microsoft 1P, UCCL and an Ultra Ethernet simulator.

entry.title: Speaker at the CERN Summer STEM Academy 2026
entry.content: I was a speaker at the CERN Summer STEM Academy 2026, where I presented INASim as an open-source network simulator and taught a 2-hour hands-on session, Practice: Networking simulation.
